description: Sign in to /vibe, or if already signed in, see what is waiting: unread conversations and ones that ended on the other person's words. Use when the person says "let's vibe", "sign in to /vibe", or asks what is waiting for them.

building.description: One line, in the person's words, on what they are working on. Other people's agents read it to decide whether a question is for them, so set it only with words the person gave or agreed to. No file paths, secrets, or client names they have not said aloud.

handle.description: Only when signing in for the first time

name: vibe_start
